classification: Partial native guideline coverage through an existing rule; not full functional equivalence.
acceptedRevision: User approved immediate/inherited recognized ARM resource bag scope, existing-rule consolidation and its recommended-preset activation.
applicability: Recognized ARM resources with a model-valued properties bag.
predicate: Existing case-insensitive authored TypeSpec property names; add systemData, preserve billingData.
notCovered: Recursive descendants, arrays/maps/unions and embedded resource envelopes.
Arbitrary non-resource definitions containing a properties member.
JSON encoded-name resolution and serialization-specific never exemptions.
No new global deduplication guarantee for bag members reused by resources.

diagnostic.target: Existing authored property target; unchanged reporting mechanism.
diagnostic.systemDataMessage: Property "systemData" is not allowed in the resource property bag. This property name is reserved for resource system metadata.

upstreamDifferences: Recursive arbitrary-definition/schema-key search, two exact name spellings, first-path/emitted-definition counting and truthy-empty-array early return are not reproduced.
